description: Prospectively binds the complete five-concern close-controller decomposition. Every listed path is an implementation surface; no package, policy, test, workflow, or generated-output path is authorized by this manifest.

rationale.scripts/run-round-close-controls.mjs: Retains only candidate bootstrap, complete structured error containment, and command dispatch.
rationale.scripts/round-close-controls/runtime.mjs: Owns deterministic serialization, hashing, process and Git execution, candidate bytes, filesystem snapshots, and state I/O.
rationale.scripts/round-close-controls/legacy.mjs: Owns retained pre-v3 compatibility commands without reminting command identities.
rationale.scripts/round-close-controls/impact.mjs: Owns change discovery, graph closure, freshness, and affected execution planning.
rationale.scripts/round-close-controls/governed.mj: Owns candidate-bound authority loading, claims, convergence, provenance, and review-topic construction.
rationale.scripts/round-close-controls/review-life: Owns review state, transport, authentication, repair evidence, terminal validation, and status.

forbidden: subprocess delegation back into the former monolith
literal argv, policy, state, output, finding, or exit changes
any test, timeout, coverage, workflow, package, or law edit
